question: What injunction of secrecy is solemnly imposed regarding this teaching of Dakṣiṇā?
premises: The teaching must be kept secret from others.
The command is addressed to the daughter of the mountain.
The injunction is affirmed as truth twice.
inference: The teaching must be strictly concealed from others, as solemnly affirmed to Pārvatī.
plain_english: Keep it secret from others, O daughter of the mountain—this is truth, truly truth.
